name: Mobile change
description: Build and verify one mobile behavior across the smallest supported platform and device matrix with safe lifecycle evidence.

outcomes.description: The requested mobile journey behaves correctly for its platform, input, lifecycle, and offline states.
The receipt names tested variants, unsupported combinations, and the safe follow-up path.

prerequisites.description: Supported platform versions, input modes, lifecycle states, and visual success criteria are known.
prerequisites.check: Write the smallest meaningful device matrix before editing.

prerequisites.description: The journey can use deterministic fixtures without signing material or private device data.
prerequisites.check: Confirm local or safe preview data is enough for the checks.

lanes.objective: Define platform, input, lifecycle, offline, accessibility, and evidence expectations.
Implement the scoped mobile behavior with deterministic fixtures and safe lifecycle handling.
Run the supported device and lifecycle matrix and record visual or interaction evidence.

qualityGates.description: Each supported platform and representative input or lifecycle variant has a result.
The intended journey, offline behavior, and failure state work without hidden signing dependencies.
Visual and test evidence is redacted and clearly states unsupported combinations.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Enter a password, one-time code, passkey, or challenge response for a device or service.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop and hand the entry to the owner; keep signing and account material out of the lane.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Authentication material is a human-only boundary.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Publish a live build, change billing or account security, perform destructive work, or execute live financial behavior.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop before the action and obtain one explicit owner confirmation for that individual action.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Mobile verification belongs in simulators, test devices, or safe previews.

rollbackRescue.rollbackPlan: Keep the previous mobile artifact or known-good integration point and narrow the matrix when a new variant fails.
rescueSteps: Capture redacted platform, lifecycle, and visual results.
Record unsupported variants rather than claiming broad coverage.
stopConditions: A required platform cannot be reproduced safely.
The change needs signing or private device data.
A protected owner boundary is reached.

redactionRules: Omit signing material, credentials, tokens, private paths, and personal device data.
Record platform names and safe build identifiers only.
